Build the tooling that handles those pipelines, hand in hand with SRE: infrastructure as code (Terraform, Helm on Kubernetes), deployment, CI/CD, secrets management, database operations and incident response. Watch over data quality and pipeline health: Grafana dashboards, alerting, and metric- and log-based observability, so failures are detected and diagnosed fast. Own data contracts and data quality: agree with the emitting squads on schemas, semantics and breaking-change rules, and enforce them with automated tests (freshness, completeness, referential integrity) that fail loudly before the data reaches its users. Deliver secure data exports to external partners and institutions. Provision and maintain dedicated PostgreSQL Research Spaces for clinical study teams, including access control and data scoping per study. Help the modelers scale their work: industrialize the dbt project so a single modelisation written by a Data Analyst is centralized, parallelized and applied across several targets. Work directly with the requesters: scope the need, challenge it, agree on what is feasible, deliver, and document. Work with the product squads on the data they emit: challenge their design upstream, and take part in the implementation on their side (TypeScript) when needed — you contribute to their code, they keep their roadmap. Participate in code reviews, technical design and continuous improvement of engineering standards. ✨ Your team Your future teammates: Mélody Ballouard and Alric Gaurier — Data Reliability Engineers. The team owns the data pipeline end to end: ingestion, transformation, exports, and the infrastructure underneath. You'll be exposed to all of it from day one. Comfort collaborating with SRE on shared infrastructure, and with scientific profiles on clinical trial data. Rigor with sensitive data: you treat patient data with the caution it deserves, by reflex. You'll work where strategic customer urgency, complex technical ambiguity, and GitLab product execution intersect. Why this role exists

Strategic customers sometimes encounter challenges that are too broad, deep, urgent, or cross-functional for any single team to own from start to finish. These challenges may involve product gaps, performance degradation, scale bottlenecks, AI governance, adoption blockers, architectural constraints, Git usage patterns, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) complexity, application programming interface (API) automation, security requirements, or operational instability.

Forward Deployed Engineering provides technical stewardship in these moments. The team doesn't simply observe, report, or escalate. Troubleshoot and resolve. This is where you earn your seat. Confirm the alert is real, gather the facts, and localise the fault: one peer or many, us or upstream, a real outage or a monitoring blip. Catch the slow degradations that never trip an alert. The day team should inherit a network in a known good state. Build and automate. The repetitive parts of this job should not stay repetitive. Write the scripts that turn a manual check into a scheduled one. Push our config automation forward (Jinja driven generation, NAPALM or NETCONF/gNMI against the devices) so changes ship from data, not from memory. When the assistive layer keeps missing the same thing, that is a candidate for automation, and you are well placed to build it during the hours nobody else is online. Move the work forward. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. About the role: We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer, Quality to build the agentic layer of how Camunda tests its software. We treat quality as an engineering discipline. We build test infrastructure the way we build our product — real design decisions, real trade-offs, real ownership. What's changing is how that work gets done: we're moving from hand-written test suites toward agents that design, generate, maintain and triage tests across the lifecycle. We need someone to build both the agents and the infrastructure that makes them dependable, and to help shape our Quality AI strategy. You'll support product teams that ship features without dedicated QA. Your job is not to become their testing safety net. It's to build the tooling and practices that let builders own quality themselves — and to stay close enough to real features to know where that tooling breaks. Camunda also ships AI capabilities in its own product, so the evaluation practice you build for agent-driven testing feeds directly into how we test non-deterministic features. You'll join colleagues who live our FAITH values: Focus, Ambition, Integrity, Talent and Humor. Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale What You’ll Be Doing: Build and operate agents across the testing lifecycle — test design, generation, maintenance, execution and failure triage. Own the infrastructure that makes agent-driven testing reliable: environments, test data, tool interfaces, guardrails, runtime and cost control. Define how we measure agent output quality, so teams can trust results instead of hand-reviewing them. Apply that evaluation practice to testing Camunda 8's own AI capabilities. Work hands-on with new features as teams build them, enough to keep the tooling honest. Raise the quality capability of teams — patterns, tooling, enablement. Success is what builders can do themselves, not the number of tests you wrote. What You Bring: Ability and/or willingness to use our product 5+ years as a software engineer. You write production code daily and would be credible on a product team; quality is your domain, not a step down from development. Production experience building test infrastructure, developer tooling or internal platforms that other engineers depend on — designed and owned, not just extended. Hands-on work with LLMs or agent frameworks: prompt and context design, tool use, handling non-determinism, and evaluating output quality. This is the differentiator for the role. Comfort with distributed systems and CI at scale. Camunda 8 is a process orchestration platform; testing it means reasoning about concurrency, state and timing. The ability to drive adoption in teams that don't report to you. You've built something another team chose to use, and you know what to do when the first version isn't picked up. Nice-to-haves: Experience evaluating or benchmarking LLM systems. Open-source contribution experience. Java, TypeScript or Python; Kubernetes and Helm. Background in developer tooling or platform engineering. description:
Fireblocks is the company bringing global finance onchain. Backed by over $1 billion in capital, we are the premier digital asset infrastructure provider trusted by thousands of industry-defining financial institutions, including banks, payment providers, fintechs, and global corporates such as BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, ANZ Bank, Western Union, Stripe, and Revolut. Built for institutional scale and security, our enterprise-grade platform and network have powered over $14 trillion in digital asset transfers worldwide.

About the Role

The Sales Engineer, Banking is a technically credible, commercially aware member of the EMEA SE team, responsible for the full technical sales cycle across banking opportunities in Western and Central Europe.

This is not a generalist SE role. You will be expected to engage deeply with treasury operations leads, custody technologists, CISOs, and risk committees inside Tier 1 and Tier 2 banks. You will need to understand how institutional banking technology works — core banking platforms, custody and settlement infrastructure, ISO 20022 and SWIFT messaging, and post-trade workflows — and be able to position Fireblocks clearly within that context. You will work closely with Banking-aligned Sales Directors across your region, taking primary responsibility for technical qualification, PoC delivery, RFP responses, and solution design from first engagement through to onboarding handoff.

What You'll Do

Technical Pre-Sales

  • Lead technical qualification for banking opportunities, distinguishing genuine digital asset programmes from exploratory noise
  • Deliver tailored product demonstrations to technical and executive audiences across custody, settlement, treasury, and compliance use cases
  • Scope, design, and deliver Proofs of Concept in bank environments — including navigating infosec review, sandbox provisioning, and API integration testing
  • Produce and own RFP, RFI, and DDQ responses for banking prospects, maintaining accuracy against Fireblocks' external security and compliance attestations
  • Present Fireblocks' security architecture to CISOs, CROs, risk committees, and product and business line leads with appropriate institutional credibility

Solution Design & Client Engagement

  • Translate institutional banking requirements — custody flows, settlement logic, treasury management, regulatory reporting — into Fireblocks solution architectures
  • Engage directly with bank technology teams on API integration patterns, core banking middleware, and operational workflow design
  • Co-develop technical account plans with Sales Directors, identifying the path from initial engagement to production deployment
  • Contribute to deal strategy on competitive situations, particularly against technology-first custody competitors

Cross-Functional Contribution

  • Act as the voice of the banking client in internal product and roadmap discussions
  • Contribute reusable technical content — solution briefs, reference architectures, PoC templates — that scale across the Banking vertical
  • Support onboarding handoff to Professional Services, ensuring continuity from sales into delivery
  • Participate in the EMEA SE enablement programme, contributing to banking-specific sessions and peer knowledge transfer

What You'll Bring

  • 3–8 years in a pre-sales, solutions engineering, or technical consulting role, selling into or supporting Tier 1 or Tier 2 banks, financial market infrastructure, or capital markets firms
  • Direct experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles in regulated financial institutions
  • Demonstrable track record of scoping and delivering PoCs or technical pilots in bank environments
  • Experience authoring RFP/RFI responses and engaging with bank procurement, legal, and infosec processes
  • Exposure to digital asset, tokenisation, or blockchain initiatives whether from a technology vendor, infrastructure provider, or within a bank's innovation function

Technical Knowledge

  • Working understanding of institutional banking architecture: core banking platforms (Temenos, Finastra, Murex, Calypso or similar), custody infrastructure, or post-trade settlement systems
  • Familiarity with financial messaging standards: ISO 20022, SWIFT MT/MX, or equivalent settlement and payment protocols
  • Comfort with API-led integration patterns; able to engage credibly in technical discussions with bank engineering and middleware teams
  • Understanding of cryptographic key management concepts, hardware security modules, or MPC/TSS architecture (formal training provided)
  • Awareness of MiCA, DORA, or equivalent EMEA regulatory requirements as they affect digital asset operations in banks

Skills & Attributes

  • Credible with senior institutional stakeholders CISO, CTO, Head of Digital Assets, treasury operations leads, and product and business line owners — not only with technical teams
  • Structured, precise communicator: able to write clearly, present confidently, and adapt register for technical and non-technical audiences
  • Commercially aware: understands deal economics, qualification discipline, and what constitutes productive SE engagement
  • Self-directed and organised, capable of running multiple active opportunities simultaneously without close supervision
  • A European language an advantage

description:
Who is Artefact?

Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organizations through data and AI. We combine the rigor of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital, and analytics to help clients achieve tangible business impact.

With 1,800+ consultants, data scientists, and engineers across 23 countries, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange, and Sanofi. Our Romandie office (Geneva/Lausanne) is at the heart of Artefact’s growth, advising clients on their most pressing strategic challenges — from AI strategy and governance to digital transformation roadmaps and new business model design.

Main Responsibilities

As a Senior Technical Consultant / Senior AI Engineer, you will lead the design and delivery of impactful AI and data solutions. You’ll combine hands-on engineering with client advisory, guiding multi-disciplinary teams from opportunity framing to production deployment.

  • Own solution architecture & delivery: Define end-to-end architectures (data, ML/LLM, APIs, security), make build/buy decisions, and drive projects from PoC to production with reliability, observability, and cost in mind.

  • Lead complex PoCs & pilots: Scope, prototype, and validate AI/ML use cases (incl. LLMs/GenAI, RAG, fine-tuning, evaluation) and convert successful pilots into scalable products.

  • Advanced programming & modeling: Build, adapt, and evaluate ML/DL/LLM models using Python (PyTorch, TensorFlow, HuggingFace, LangChain/LlamaIndex), including prompt engineering, fine-tuning/LoRA, vector search, and safety/guardrails.

  • Cloud & MLOps/LLMOps: Design and operate solutions on Azure, GCP, or AWS (CI/CD, containers, model serving, feature stores, vector DBs, monitoring, eval pipelines).

  • Client advisory & stakeholder management: Translate business goals into technical roadmaps, present to senior stakeholders, manage risks and trade-offs, and ensure measurable business impact.

  • Quality, security & governance: Enforce best practices on data privacy, model risk management, responsible AI, and documentation.

  • Team leadership & mentoring: Coach engineers/consultants, perform code and design reviews, and help shape delivery standards and reusable accelerators.

  • Pre-sales & thought leadership: Support proposals, estimates, and statements of work; contribute to assets, talks, and publications that advance Artefact’s AI offering.

Candidate Profile

Engineer first, consultant second — with a builder’s mindset and a track record of shipping.

  • Experience: 5–8+ years in data/ML/AI engineering or adjacent roles, including end-to-end delivery of production AI systems (not just prototypes).

  • Programming: Expert Python; solid software engineering (testing, packaging, CI/CD). SQL required; Java/Scala/TypeScript a plus.

  • AI/ML: Hands-on with ML/DL and LLMs (prompting, fine-tuning/LoRA, embeddings/RAG, evaluation & observability, guardrails).

  • Cloud: Deep experience on at least one major cloud (Azure, GCP, or AWS) deploying secure, scalable services.

  • MLOps/LLMOps: Containers (Docker/Kubernetes), Git, pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions/Cloud-native), model serving (FastAPI/TorchServe/Triton), experiment tracking, model registry, vector DBs (FAISS, Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch).

  • Architecture & data: Designing data/ML platforms, APIs, microservices; familiarity with data pipelines and streaming is valued.

  • Consulting skills: Requirements gathering, storytelling, senior stakeholder management, and clear documentation.

  • Languages: Fluency in French and English (written & spoken).

  • Work eligibility: You must be eligible to work in Switzerland.

Nice to have

  • Experience with responsible AI/governance frameworks, security reviews, and cost optimization.

  • Domain experience in one or more industries (e.g., retail, pharma, manufacturing, finance).

  • Contributions to open-source, publications, or conference talks.

Why Join Us

  • Strategy with a Data Edge: Operate at the intersection of boardroom strategy and cutting-edge AI engineering.

  • Romandie Office Impact: High visibility from day one; help shape our Swiss footprint and work directly with senior leadership.

  • Learning & Growth: Advanced training across strategy, AI/ML/LLM, and cloud; international missions and communities of practice.

  • Culture of Doers: Innovation, action, collaboration. We move fast, deliver impact, and support each other’s growth.

Location: Lausanne / Geneva (Romandie)

If you don’t meet 100% of the criteria, we still want to hear from you. Passion, curiosity, and impact orientation matter — tell us about yours.

description:
Who is Artefact?

Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organisations through data and AI. We combine the rigour of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital and analytics to help clients achieve tangible business impact.

With 2,500+ consultants, data scientists and engineers, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange and Sanofi. Our Swiss offices are at the heart of Artefact’s growth, advising clients on their most pressing strategic challenges — from AI strategy and governance to digital transformation roadmaps and new business model design.

Main Responsibilities

As a Senior Consultant in our Zurich/Lausanne office, you will work at the intersection of strategy consulting and data and AI delivery. You will:

  • Strategy Development: Work with client leadership teams to address high-stakes questions. How can AI reshape our business model? How should we govern and organise for data? Which strategic programmes deliver the most impact?
  • Structured Problem-Solving: Break complex challenges down into decisions a client can act on, combining consulting rigour with a working knowledge of what current AI can and cannot actually do.
  • Solution Design: Turn a business question into a solution shape — what data it depends on, what kind of platform or product it should sit on, and what “good” looks like once it is built. You will do this alongside our data scientists and engineers.
  • Project Delivery: Support engagements end to end, from hypothesis framing and market and competitor analysis through to data maturity assessments, client workshops, governance design and implementation roadmaps.
  • Client Engagement: Work closely with C-level stakeholders and business unit leaders. You will build trusted relationships, communicate recommendations with clarity, and keep the work aligned to what the client is actually trying to decide.
  • Knowledge & Practice Building: Contribute to the growth of Artefact's Zurich office by shaping new offerings, creating intellectual capital - frameworks, thought pieces, benchmarks - and taking part in business development.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who can hold a technical position and a commercial one at the same time. The strongest candidates meet most of the following.

  • Education: A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Business, Economics or a related field.
  • Work Experience: Around three to five years in consulting, or in a technical/date-focussed role with client-facing responsibility. 
  • Business Acumen & AI Fluency: A genuine dual affinity for business and technology. You are comfortable with modern data and AI concepts - generative AI and LLMs, retrieval, predictive machine learning, cloud platforms - and with what they cost and where they fail, not only with what they are called.
  • Technical Depth: You have built AI or data products, not only advised on them. You can explain why you chose which model you put on which part of the work, and what that choice did to both output quality and cost. You will not be writing production code in this role, but you should have the basic understanding.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills: Strong quantitative and analytical skills, and the judgement to know which number actually decides the question. You are comfortable getting to a defensible estimate with your assumptions stated out loud.
  • Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication. You enjoy working in teams and in front of clients.
  • Languages: Fluency in German/French and English, written and spoken, is strongly preferred.. 
  • Work Eligibility: You must be eligible to work in Switzerland.

Why Join Us

  • Strategy and the Build: Artefact is neither a traditional strategy consultancy nor a pure technology player. You will move between the boardroom and the build, and be expected to be credible in both.
  • Engineers, not hand-offs: Our 2,500 people include the data scientists and engineers you will work beside on the same engagement - not a delivery organisation you hand a slide deck to.
  • Zurich Office Impact: As part of a growing Swiss team you will have visibility and impact from the first day. You will help shape Artefact's footprint in the region and work directly with senior leadership.
  • Learning & Growth: Regular training in both consulting method and AI and data capability, combined with international exposure.
  • Culture of Doers: Innovation, action, collaboration. We are entrepreneurial and fast-moving, committed to delivering impact while supporting each other's growth.

This position is based in Zürich or Lausanne.

Role

This Data Engineer directly supports the Special Operations Command - Africa (SOCAF) based at Kelley Barracks in Stuttgart, Germany. Data Engineers in this program support the command through a combination of data governance and data modernization efforts. Data Engineers will be embedded within SOCAF to provide subject matter expertise and technical capability for integrating complex data used by the command. Data Engineers in this program support SOCAF's initiative to be more capable and effective when leveraging their data resources.

Responsibilities

A Data Engineer has a deep understanding of performance optimization and data pipelining. In addition to the baseline skills of a data analyst, data engineers can make raw data more useful for the enterprise. Data Engineers can create and integrate application programming interfaces (APIs). Their technical skills generally include multiple programming languages and a deep knowledge of SQL database design. 

The Data Engineer role requires a more in-depth knowledge in programming for integrating complex models and using advanced software library frameworks to distribute large, clustered data sets. Data engineers collect and arrange data in a form that is useful for analytics. A basic knowledge in machine learning is also required to build efficient and accurate data pipelines to meet the needs for downstream users such as data scientists to create the models and analytics that produce insight.

The Senior Data Engineer shall perform the following tasks:

  • Developing, maintaining, and testing infrastructures for data generation to transform data from various structured and unstructured data sources. 
  • Develop complex queries to ensure accessibility while optimizing the performance of NoSQL and or big data infrastructure. Create and maintain optimal data pipeline architecture.
  • Build and maintain the infrastructure to support extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) of data from a wide variety of data sources. Extract data from multiple data sources, relational SQL and NoSQL databases, and other platform APIs, for data ingestion and integration. 
  • Configure and manage data analytic frameworks and pipelines using databases and tools such as NoSQL, SQL, HDInsight, MongoDB, Cassandra, Neo4j, GraphDB, OrientDB, Spark, Hadoop, Kafka, Hive, and Pig. 
  • Apply distributed systems concepts and principles such as consistency and availability, liveness and safety, durability, reliability, fault-tolerance, consensus algorithms.
  • Administrate cloud computing and CI/CD pipelines to include Azure, Google, and Amazon Web Service (AWS).
  • Coordinate with stakeholders, including product, data and design teams to assist with data-related technical issues and support their data infrastructure needs

Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

Vinted’s Marketing domain is growing - we’re on a mission to make Vinted known and loved as the go-to destination for everything second-hand. Marketing is one of the primary drivers behind our biggest strategic goals, from winning the USA market to expanding beyond fashion into a multi-vertical platform.

We’re looking a Senior Data Scientist to join our Marketing Data Science and Analytics team to hands-on build, refine, and scale our core predictive and explanatory models. In this role, you will be the technical engine behind our Bayesian Media Mix Models (MMM), user value machine learning models, and advanced statistical frameworks. Your focus will be on engineering robust, high-performing models that transform complex data into the precise insights our domain relies on.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Evolve Our Marketing Measurement: Code, calibrate, and scale our Bayesian Media Mix Models (MMM) and ROI frameworks to unlock precise business insights.
  • Build and Deploy Core Models: Build and maintain sophisticated econometric and statistical models (MMM, GMV, engagement) to quantify marketing impact and guide multi-channel growth.
  • Automate Model Validation & Health Monitoring: Design automated frameworks and reliability metrics that continuously monitor model health and ensure long-term accuracy.
  • Build Next-Gen, Automated Capabilities: Drive the ambition toward intelligent data products [such as self-healing MMMs] using modern AI and automation to optimize model runtimes and scale our ecosystem as Vinted grows.
  • Partner Decision Scientists & Marketing Leadership: Act as the core technical partner, translating complex mechanics into clear concepts and helping the team connect model outputs to robust business decisions.
  • Champion Modelling Excellence: Maintain a high bar for code quality, rigorous validation, and reproducibility to ensure our data science practices remain clean and trusted.

About you 

  • Proven Data Science Experience: Hands-on experience focused on advanced statistical, econometric, or time-series modelling (experience in marketing measurement/MMM is an advantage).
  • Deep Theoretical Knowledge: Strong foundation in advanced statistics, causal inference, and regression. Familiarity with probabilistic programming (e.g., PyMC) is a major plus.
  • Research-to-Application Mindset: Ability to read scientific papers, explore state-of-the-art techniques, and replicate or adapt advanced methodologies to solve complex problems.
  • Production-Grade Engineering: Highly proficient in Python, with a passion for building models as data products. You design your pipelines and code so they are modular, reproducible, and easily used or extended by other scientists.
  • Business-Minded Tech Partner: You care deeply about the why behind your code, naturally connecting technical model outputs to commercial metrics and business outcomes.
  • Educational Background: A Master’s or PhD degree in a highly quantitative discipline (Statistics, Econometrics, Mathematics, Data Science, or similar).
  • Impactful storyteller: A charismatic and confident presenter who navigates any topic’s technicality, actively driving and facilitating strategic business conversations across both technical and leadership audiences.

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 30 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per your workday
  • Frequent team-building events
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Access to a discounted gym membership plan
  • Pension Plan with Vinted matching 150% of your chosen contribution
  • Supplemental Private Health Insurance
  • Life and Disability insurance
  • A subsidised Deutschlandticket for your commute to the office by public transport
  • A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation Policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual Learning Budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid Work 

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal Opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

€74.000—€100.100 EUR

Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.
 
If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

The position

This is an exciting time to join Remote and make a personal difference in the global employment space in Employee Lifecycle Operations, by joining our Employee Lifecycle team.

As a Senior Lifecycle Specialist (OHS), you will ensure that all activities related to the occupational health and safety of employees are performed effectively, compliantly, and on time across multiple countries supported by Remote. You will be responsible for identifying, engaging, and managing vendor partnerships, driving contract management processes, and be in charge of rolling out all events related to health and safety across the globe for Remote’s employees.

You will be reporting to Employee Lifecycle Manager.

Requirements

  • Significant work experience in a digital environment
  • BA/BS degree or equivalent.
  • Progressive management plus required examiner experience within Workers’ Compensation insurance industry.
  • Experience scouting, onboarding, and/or managing insurance partners and brokers
  • Ability to quickly engage and support external employees and vendors across multiple countries
  • Good analytical skills, ability to map processes
  • Team player who works independently and communicates proactively and positively
  • A growth and problem-solving mindset. You can shift tasks and priorities when circumstances change and do so quickly and effectively
  • Writes and speaks fluent English.
  • It is not required to have experience working remotely, but considered a plus

Key Responsibilities

Insurance Portfolio Management:

  • Assist in the administration and management of the company’s global insurance programs specifically Worker Compensation insurance.
  • Support the renewal process for various insurance programs, ensuring timely and accurate submissions and successful negotiations to drive cost efficiencies and competitiveness in the market.
  • Coordinate with brokers, insurers, and internal stakeholders to gather the necessary information and documentation.
  • Maintain up-to-date records of insurance policies, certificates of insurance, and related documentation.

Risk Financing:

  • Analyze and evaluate risk financing options to optimize coverage and cost-efficiency.
  • Prepare and present recommendations on risk financing strategies to senior management.
  • Assist in the development and implementation of risk management policies and procedures.

Data Analysis and Reporting:

  • Collect, analyze, and interpret insurance and risk management data.
  • Prepare regular reports and presentations for senior management.
  • Identify trends, potential risks, and opportunities for improvement.

Stakeholder Engagement:

  • Collaborate with various internal departments and operating companies to identify and address insurance and risk management needs.
  • Foster strong relationships with clients and external partners, including brokers, insurers, and regulatory agencies.
  • Maintains current knowledge of related laws and regulation

Customer Support:

  • Provide prospects, customers and their employees with the necessary support on Workers Compensation insurance coverage, exclusions and overall risk management advise
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation for claims management procedures and records of claims outcomes
  • Collaborate closely with the Occupational Health and Safety team, brokers, and insurers to support the claim management process for both internal and external employees

Practicals

  • You'll report to: Senior Manager, Contract management, Lifecycle
  • Team: Lifecycle Operations
  • Location: EMEA 
  • Start date: As soon as possible

Application process

  1. Interview with recruiter
  2. Interview with future manager
  3. Team Interview
  4. Executive Interview
  5. Bar Raiser
  6. Offer
  7. Background Check

 

Remote's Total Rewards philosophy is to ensure fair, unbiased compensation and fair equity pay along with competitive benefits in all locations in which we operate. We do not agree to or encourage cheap-labor practices and therefore we ensure to pay above in-location rates. We hope to inspire other companies to support global talent-hiring and bring local wealth to developing countries.

At first glance our salary bands seem quite wide - here is some context. At Remote we have international operations and a globally distributed workforce.  We use geo ranges to consider geographic pay differentials as part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive in various markets while we hiring globally.

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location, and our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay for the successful candidate in this role is dependent upon many factors such as location, transferable or job-related skills, work experience, relevant training, business needs, and market demands. The base salary range may be subject to change.

At Remote, we foster internal mobility as a key element of our culture of employee growth and development, supported by a compensation philosophy that guarantees pay equity and fairness. Therefore, all compensation changes associated with an internal move will be reviewed by the Total Rewards & People Enablement team on a case by case basis.

€55.800—€62.800 EUR

Benefits

Our full benefits & perks are explained in our handbook at remote.com/r/benefits. As a global company, each country works differently, but some benefits/perks are for all Remoters:
  • work from anywhere
  • flexible paid time off

  • budget towards co-working spaces, learning and wellness (including gym memberships)

  • stock options

How you’ll plan your day (and life)

We work async at Remote which means you can plan your schedule around your life (and not around meetings). Read more at remote.com/async.

You will be empowered to take ownership and be proactive. When in doubt you will default to action instead of waiting. Your life-work balance is important and you will be encouraged to put yourself and your family first, and fit work around your needs.

If that sounds like something you want, apply now!

The role 

Nebius Token Factory is building fast, reliable, and cost-efficient inference services for frontier models. As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer on our Applied AI team, you will own model and endpoint optimization from model artifacts through production deployment. Your work will span model internals, inference engines, serving architecture, and benchmarking, with a focus on improving latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, and cost per token while maintaining model quality and reliability.

This is a hands-on role in which you will work on complex optimization projects, diagnose difficult serving problems, and deliver measurable improvements in production. Working closely with kernel and platform engineers, you will evaluate serving configurations, resolve performance and quality regressions, and optimize inference for real-world workloads, supported by reproducible benchmarks and safe production rollouts.

Your responsibilities: 

  • Own optimization work for specific model families, customer endpoints, or serving backends.

  • Run engine comparisons and recommend practical serving configurations for specific workloads.

  • Debug model quality or performance regressions during production rollouts.

  • Optimize LLM and VLM endpoints for latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, quality, and cost per token.

  • Build and productionize model-compression workflows, including quantization, quantization-aware training, distillation, low-bit serving, and accuracy recovery.

  • Implement or integrate speculative decoding, draft-model approaches, KV-cache optimization, prefix caching, chunked prefill, continuous batching, and disaggregated prefill/decode serving.

  • Build reproducible benchmark harnesses for TTFT, TPOT, tokens per second per GPU, p95/p99 latency, GPU memory, reliability, and cost per token.

  • Partner with GPU kernel engineers and platform engineers to diagnose bottlenecks across model code, kernels, runtime, scheduler, gateway, and cluster layers.

  • Write clear design docs, performance reports, rollout plans, and customer-facing technical explanations.

Must-haves: 

  • Strong Python and PyTorch engineering skills.

  • Hands-on experience deploying or optimizing LLM, VLM, or high-throughput transformer inference systems.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with distillation, speculative decoding, EAGLE, Medusa, multi-token prediction, or other inference acceleration methods.

  • Experience with agentic workloads, including tool calling, structured outputs, streaming APIs, high concurrency, and multi-step orchestration.

  • CUDA or Triton familiarity, even if the role is not primarily a kernel-engineering role.

About Parloa

Parloa’s mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience - one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About the role:

As a Sr Partner Agent Architect at Parloa, you will operate at the intersection of enterprise solution architecture, conversational AI, and partner enablement, helping strategic partners and enterprise customers design, implement, and scale AI-driven customer experiences. This is a highly consultative, customer-facing role where you will guide partners and clients through solution discovery, end-to-end solution architecture, enterprise integration design, conversational architecture, and implementation strategy for enterprise AI Agents. You will design how Parloa’s platform integrates into complex enterprise environments, solve multi-system integration challenges, and apply systems thinking to build reliable, scalable AI solutions. While you bring strong technical depth and can build when needed, your primary focus will be helping partners shape the right technical solutions, architect scalable integrations, prioritize effectively, and successfully operationalize Parloa’s platform within complex enterprise environments. You will also help shape the conversational experience layer by translating customer requirements into AI Agent behavior through prompt engineering, LLM concepts, and conversational design. Prior conversational design experience is valuable but can be further developed on the job. You will work closely with strategic partners, enterprise customers, Partner Success Managers, Technical Program Managers, Forward Deployed Engineers, Solution Engineers, and the broader Agent Architect organization to drive successful AI deployments and long-term customer value.

This is your opportunity to shape how enterprise organizations and global partners adopt agentic AI at scale while acting as a trusted advisor across both business and technical stakeholders.

Areas of ownership:

  • Scope and design end-to-end AI Agent deployments across complex enterprise environments.
  • Define how Parloa integrates with systems such as CRMs, ERPs, ticketing platforms, contact center technologies, and other enterprise applications.
  • Apply systems thinking to solve complex multi-system data flows, dependencies, and integration challenges.
  • Guide partners and customers on API design, authentication, data transformation, field mapping, error handling, and integration patterns.
  • Build, configure, test, or troubleshoot integrations using REST APIs, webhooks, JSON/XML payloads, and tools such as Postman.
  • Collaborate with Forward Deployed Engineers on complex or custom integration scenarios beyond standard platform capabilities.
  • Lead technical discovery workshops, architecture reviews, and solution design sessions with partner and customer stakeholders.
  • Translate customer workflows and business requirements into structured conversational components and reliable AI Agent behavior.
  • Apply knowledge of LLMs, prompting strategies, embeddings, and context management to improve agent performance.

Purpose of Position 

Awin's Unlock the Clock (UTC) programme is building the evidence base and infrastructure to move measurement beyond last click, using deterministic, CDN/edge-level signals and advanced data connections from publishers to show the full-funnel and AI-discovery influence that today's attribution misses. The value of that dataset scales with the quality and scale of the publishers inside it.

This role exists to acquire and retain those publishers. The Senior Partnerships Manager, Media & Data owns the end-to-end pursuit of medium-to-large global media publications and publisher groups, from first conversation to signature, to live, verified data flowing, and is responsible for building the commercial value exchange that makes Awin the leading partner for a premium publisher to work with. The focus in year one is a small number of flagship, tier-one lighthouse partnerships that prove the model and become the reference cases the rest of the market follows.

This is a new, dedicated role. It is not general publisher account management: the postholder is hired to spearhead these relationships and nothing else.

 

Key Responsibilities 

Land flagship media partnerships

  • Build and own a global target list of medium-to-large media publications and publisher groups whose audience, content and commerce activity make them high-value contributors to Awin’s deterministic dataset.
  • Own the full pursuit cycle for those targets: identify, qualify, pitch, negotiate, close and hand into onboarding, personally leading senior conversations with commercial, ecommerce, editorial and digital leadership.
  • Deliver a defined number of tier-one lighthouse partnerships in year one: signed tracking addendum, technically onboarded, and verifiably recording events at agreed volume and quality thresholds.
  • Convert those wins into reference cases, including case studies, joint narratives and referenceable contacts, that materially shorten the sales cycle for the next tranche of publishers.

Build the publisher value proposition

  • Own and continuously sharpen the answer to “what’s in it for the publisher”: the commercial, editorial and strategic reasons a premium media owner shares CDN and wider data signals with Awin.
  • Construct and negotiate the value exchange, including new revenue lines, advertiser demand, insight and benchmarking, or commercial terms
  • Work with Product, Marketing and the workstream owners to translate AI-visibility and full-funnel capability into publisher-facing propositions, collateral and retailer pricing
  • Help each partner build their own value proposition, so the publisher has something new and differentiated to sell to advertisers, not simply a new tag on their site.
  • Equip partners to sell that proposition through joint collateral, benchmarks, proof points and training for their commercial and editorial teams.
  • Feed publisher objections, commercial expectations and market intelligence back into the project roadmap so the product earns the deals rather than the deals stretching the product.

Own the technical and contractual path to live

  • Run the integration conversation with publishes, covering CDN/edge worker or plugin deployment, tag and consent implications, data scope and page performance, with Awin product brought in for deep technical detail.
  • Own the commercial and legal process end to end, including tracking addendum, data-sharing terms, privacy and consent positions, working with Legal and Privacy to reach repeatable rather than bespoke agreements.
  • Hold partners accountable to going live and staying live, tracking signed-to-verified-event conversion

Global reach and internal leadership

  • Operate globally from day one across UK, EU and US, coordinating with local Awin market and Publisher Development teams and identified regional representatives rather than duplicating them.
  • Act as the single point of accountability and internal voice for media partner acquisition within the project: represent the workstream in relevant forums and provide clear, honest pipeline and progress reporting to SteerCo level.
  • Partner with the advertiser-facing teams so publisher supply and advertiser demand are sequenced together: the data has to be sold on as well as signed up.
  • Represent Awin externally at key industry events, conferences and partner forums to promote Unlock the Clock and Awin’s fuller-funnel measurement strategy to the media community.
  • Build the playbook: document what works, so the model can be scaled by others and, in time, by a small team reporting into this role.

Success measures (first 12 months)

  • Signed and live tier-one lighthouse partnerships against an agreed target, evidenced by verified event volume
  • A qualified, weighted global pipeline of medium-to-large media groups with credible forward visibility.
  • A repeatable publisher proposition and commercial framework: not a series of bespoke negotiations.
  • Partner-facing value propositions live in market, with at least two partners actively selling an Awin-enabled proposition of their own.
  • Referenceable partners willing to advocate publicly, at least one flagship case study in market, and Awin represented on stage at relevant industry events.
  • Measurable advertiser-side pull-through from the partnerships landed, agreed jointly with the advertiser teams.

 

Key Skills

  • 7+ years in commercial, partnership or account leadership roles, with a significant portion earned publisher-side or media-owner-side.
  • An established personal network of senior contacts across the media and publishing world that can be activated from day one. This is a prerequisite, not a nice-to-have.
  • Experience representing an organisation publicly: speaking at industry events, on panels or at partner forums.
  • Demonstrable track record of senior-level relationships inside premium publishers or media groups, including commercial directors, heads of ecommerce, editorial and digital leadership.
  • Experience negotiating and closing commercial agreements with, or on behalf of, publishers: tenancy, CPC, CPA, fixed fee, data or licensing deals.
  • Working knowledge of the affiliate and performance ecosystem and how publishers monetise content, for example Awin, Skimlinks, Rakuten, Partnerize, Impact or similar.
  • Experience selling or landing something new, a product, model or proposition without an established category, rather than managing an existing book of business.
  • Comfortable navigating multi-stakeholder deals spanning commercial, editorial, legal, privacy and technical teams.
  • International exposure across at least two of UK, US and DACH/EMEA markets.
  • Desirable: experience with content licensing, AI/LLM discovery, SEO/AEO, or data partnership deals.
  • Commercially creative, able to construct a value exchange where no price list exists.
  • Relationship builder with genuine credibility at senior level.
  • Strong negotiator, comfortable with ambiguity and long sales cycles.
  • Excellent storyteller: can turn technical capability into a publisher-relevant revenue narrative.
  • Confident, credible public speaker, comfortable on stage and in front of a room as a visible advocate for Awin’s strategy.
  • Self-starting and resilient. This is a build role, not a maintain role.
  • Collaborative and low-ego; comfortable pulling in engineering, legal, product and local market teams.
  • Analytically confident: fluent in performance data, able to interrogate reporting and defend a number.
  • Strategic mindset paired with a bias to action and closing.
  • Technically literate rather than technical: able to hold a credible conversation about tags, tracking, CDNs and edge/worker deployments, page performance and data flows, and to know when to bring engineering into the room.

description:
IDnow is a leader in digital identity and fraud prevention in Europe with a mission to transform trust into the most powerful asset in the digital world, empowering enterprises with AI-driven, SaaS-based identity solutions that deliver scalable security, adaptive compliance, and real-time fraud prevention. Through its broad portfolio of digital identity and fraud prevention solutions, IDnow establishes, maintains and enriches trust throughout the customer journey, ensuring businesses can confidently and securely operate while leveraging digital identity to drive growth, security and scalability.

The company has offices in Germany, United Kingdom, Romania and France, and is backed by renowned institutional investors, including Corsair Capital and Seventure Partners. Its portfolio of international clients spans a wide range of end markets including financial services, telecommunications, travel & mobility, gaming, and other industries.

 

 

This position is based in Rennes/Paris, France and a fixed term(full time) contract of 1 year as a maternity replacement. 

 

As (Senior) Product Manager, Trust Platform – Digital Identities(f/m/d), you own the product direction for how IDnow's Trust Platform supports European eID schemes and EUDI Wallets. You define the strategy for digital identity methods, act as the counterpart to IDnow's Trust Services team, and ensure the platform stays ahead of eIDAS 2.0 requirements as they become mandatory across the EU. This is a focused, partially technical role that requires depth over breadth: you go deep into the specifications of eID schemes and EUDI Wallets rather than staying at a surface level. 

Key Responsibilities 

You shape how IDnow's Trust Platform supports digital identities across Europe, ensuring customers can rely on compliant, seamless, and secure identification methods. 

  • Strategic Portfolio: Define the digital identity strategy and portfolio of identification methods for EUDI Wallets and eIDs, evaluating and deciding between direct integrations and broker-based approaches. 
  • Trust Services Counterpart: Act as the counterpart to IDnow's Trust Services team and ensure a smooth integration of electronic signatures, Qualified Electronic Attestations of Attributes (QEAAs), and related trust services into the Trust Platform. 
  • Regulatory Leadership: Stay ahead of eIDAS 2.0 and EUDI Wallet standards, tracking evolving technical specifications and implementing acts to ensure the platform is compliant well before deadlines hit. 
  • Identity Interoperability: Ensure seamless cross-border identity verification, managing the nuances of different EU member state requirements, national eID schemes, and trust frameworks. 
  • Conversion Optimization: Analyze the friction-versus-security trade-off for each identification method and provide clear recommendations to help customers maximize their onboarding rates. 
  • Own the end-to-end specification of eID and EUDI Wallet integrations, going into technical detail on protocols, data models, and trust frameworks.  
  • Collaborate closely with Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and Solutions teams to translate regulatory requirements into concrete product and technical specifications. 

Turn back if…

• You are not comfortable diving into regulatory requirements in depth and becoming a subject matter expert on EUDI wallets and national eID schemes.
• You're most comfortable in a traditional product-owner role centred on backlog management and delivery, rather than shaping strategy and technical specifications..
• You want a fully structured environment where every process and specification is already documented — this role is about defining the direction while the standards themselves are still evolving..
• You're not willing to travel frequently to Rennes or work across multiple jurisdictions and member-state requirements..

 

Preferred Experience 

  • Bring 5 + product management experience  with end-to-end ownership of product strategy, discovery, prioritisation, delivery, and continuous improvement, ideally in a regulated or standards-driven environment. 
  • Knowledge of eID schemes or EUDI Wallets is a strong plus – you are comfortable navigating technical specifications, protocols, and regulatory texts in depth, not just at a conceptual level. 
  • Knowledge of Identity & Access Management and authentication protocols such as OIDC, SAML, and OAuth is a strong plus. 
  • Demonstrate experience in digital identity, trust services, fraud prevention, compliance, or a regulated industry such as banking, fintech, insurance, or telecommunications. 
  • Show a high level of autonomy and ownership: this is a focused scope that requires a strong, detail-oriented executor who can work independently while always keeping track of business metrics and customer feedback. 
  • Communicate complex regulatory and technical topics clearly to engineering teams, senior stakeholders, customers, and internal enablement audiences. 
  • Willingness to be based in or travel frequently to Rennes, France, to work closely with the local team. 
  • Fluency in English and French is required; additional European languages are a plus given the cross-border, multi-jurisdictional nature of the role. 

Perks & Benefits 

  • Health & Wellbeing: Use your full access to the mental health platform nilo, including 1on1 sessions. 
  • We value personal and professional development: make full use of Udemy, our training platform with 24/7 access and unlimited licences. 
  • We make your remote work comfy: we provide support on equipment and offer flexible working hours. 
  • We value collaboration & love to come together: regular onsite gatherings, internal initiatives and summer parties to connect across teams. 
  • May your family require your attention or other reasons apply: use the benefits of our parental leave policy or our sabbatical programme. 
  • In addition to the perks & benefits above, we offer specific benefits that differ between our locations.

Including but not limited to: race or ethnic origin, religion or convictions, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, disability, age, or sexual orientation.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. Location This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region. Project Manager: You get customers live end to end, several in parallel: guided onboarding for commercial customers, leading enterprise projects yourself, or a workstream on our largest programs. Typically you bring 2+ years in consulting, implementation or project management. Senior Project Manager: You make large, global transformations happen: multiple ERPs, entities and countries, the steering committee, and a blp team on each engagement. Typically you bring 5+ years delivering complex, multi-country programs. Next steps: Lead a delivery team, or move into Consulting and from there towards our Client Partner role on strategic accounts. Moves into Consulting or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them. Key Responsibilities Run implementations end to end: kick-off, scope, planning, configuration, testing and go-live. Manage several customers in parallel at different stages, and keep every one of them on date. Work with customers on their processes, and flag early where a process assumption will not hold. Coordinate the specialists on your projects: Integrations Engineers, Technical Project Managers and AI Automation Specialists. Own scope actively. description:
ReqID: FEQ427R340

Location:  London

Skills: Networking, Security, Platform, DevOps, Databricks, Cloud - AWS, GCP, Azure, Infrastructure

The Role

As an Infrastructure & Platform Specialist Solutions Architect (SSA), you will serve as a trusted technical advisor, guiding enterprise customers through the architecture, administration, and security of their Databricks deployments on their cloud of choice (AWS, Azure, or GCP). You combine deep technical expertise with strategic thinking to position Databricks as the foundation of your customers' data and AI strategy.

The Impact You Will Have

  • Guide strategic customers through the full lifecycle of Databricks on their cloud platform, including platform administration from initial architectural design to production deployment
  • Architect secure, scalable enterprise deployments that satisfy complex cloud networking (virtual networks, private connectivity), identity (cloud IAM and enterprise identity providers), and security compliance standards
  • Serve as a subject matter expert in core areas such as cloud infrastructure, infrastructure-as-code (IaC), cloud networking, and identity management
  • Drive technical wins in competitive scenarios by demonstrating Databricks' differentiation through custom-built solutions
  • Orchestrate cross-functional resources (DSAs, SAs, FDE, Partners) to deliver comprehensive solutions for complex customer needs
  • Influence product direction by providing structured feedback on customer requirements and competitive gaps

What We Look For

  • 8+ years in solutions architecture, technical pre-sales, or a senior hands-on technical role
  • Advanced expertise across the following areas:
    • Security & Identity: Cloud security controls, platform/network/data security, encryption, vulnerability management, compliance, and identity protocols. This includes cloud-native IAM (AWS IAM, Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD, Google Cloud IAM), enterprise identity services (AWS IAM Identity Center, Entra ID, Google Cloud Identity), and federation standards (SCIM, OAuth, SAML, OIDC)
    • Networking & Deployments: Enterprise cloud networking (VPC/VNet design and peering, dedicated interconnects such as AWS Direct Connect / Azure ExpressRoute / Google Cloud Interconnect, and private connectivity such as AWS PrivateLink / Azure Private Link / GCP Private Service Connect), network routing, performance optimisation, and large-scale deployment management
    • Platform Administration: High availability, disaster recovery, cluster orchestration, observability and audit (e.g. Amazon CloudWatch / CloudTrail, Azure Monitor, Google Cloud Operations Suite), and cloud cost management
    • Infrastructure Automation (InfraOps): Hands-on automation using IaC tools (e.g. Terraform, plus cloud-native tooling such as AWS CloudFormation / CDK, Azure Resource Manager / Bicep, or Google Cloud Deployment Manager) to build, maintain, and scale complex cloud environments
  • Strong coding proficiency in Python and SQL: you must demonstrate live coding, debugging, and solution-building skills
  • Deep expertise in distributed data systems architecture: designing scalable pipelines, streaming architectures, lakehouse patterns, and cloud-native data platforms
  • Proficient in the Databricks Platform
  • Proven ability to lead architecture discussions with senior technical stakeholders: whiteboarding, design reviews, and trade-off analysis
  • Track record of driving platform adoption and consumption growth within accounts
  • Coach and develop other team members on technical depth, customer engagement, and use case prioritisation
  • Contribute to Field Engineering thought leadership through customer-facing content, workshops, and community engagement
  • Excellent communication skills: able to translate complex architectures into business value for both technical and executive audiences
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a quantitative discipline (or equivalent experience)
  • Willingness to travel up to 30% as needed

Nice to Have:

  • Databricks certifications
  • Cloud provider certifications at professional level (e.g. AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional or AWS Certified Data Engineer; Azure Solutions Architect Expert; Google Professional Cloud Architect)
  • Experience with competitive platforms (Snowflake, cloud-native data services, Azure Synapse, BigQuery) — understanding the landscape you'll position against
  • Background in a data/AI company or cloud provider



About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Product

In a rapidly evolving world, trust in AI depends on AI agents being grounded in fresh, verified real-world data. Search is the foundation that makes this possible.

We are building an agent-native search platform designed specifically for AI systems rather than human users. Our product provides programmatic, low-latency, and observable search APIs that AI agents use to retrieve, filter, and reason over real-world information at scale.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to work on the runtime systems of a novel search engine tailored for agentic AI consumption.

In this role, you will focus on building low-latency, high-throughput systems that serve search queries in real time. You will work on the critical path of user-facing requests, where performance, predictability, and efficiency directly impact product quality. You will design and operate systems that handle thousands of requests per second under strict latency budgets, optimising every layer from request handling to data access and response assembly.

In this position, your responsibility will be to

  • Design, implement, and operate core runtime services for serving search queries at scale
  • Build and optimise request flows, including query processing, retrieval orchestration, and response assembly under strict latency budgets
  • Develop systems that maintain performance and predictability under high load

description:
WHY JOIN ALO?

Mindful movement. It’s at the core of why we do what we do at ALO—it’s our calling. Because mindful movement in the studio leads to better living. It changes who yogis are off the mat, making their lives and their communities better. That’s the real meaning of studio-to-street: taking the consciousness from practice on the mat and putting it into practice in life.

OBJECTIVE

The Operations Manager is a member of the store leadership team who deals with Alo’s operational strategy in the store. This individual is passionate about inventory management, labor planning and scheduling – all with a lens on driving an efficient and effective store operation. This role’s north star is pointed at ensuring that the store is customer-ready at all times.  

Operations Leader 

  • Oversee and support execution of key operational processes 
  • Investigate and root cause inventory accuracy issues, partnering with the Manager to escalate process or system gaps
  • Champion strong Operational standards for the salesfloor by leveraging business performance data
  • Support sell-through management by ensuring accuracy of inventory counts and coordinates labor hours to efficiently receive product deliveries
  • Support a safe work environment and efficient operation  

Business Leader  

  • Represent the business in meetings and on conference calls, in partnership with General Manager
  • Review, Monitor and partner with General Manager to manage the budget, reporting and other business data; including metrics (e.g. Expenses, Sell-Thru) and inform planning processes (e.g., quarterly business review and sales planning)
  • Future planning workflow business needs to protect optimal performance 

People Leader 

  • Ensure that the Operations team exudes Alo's mission and Guiding Principles to effectively communicate to our visitors who we are, what we do and why we do what we do
  • Leads a team through accountability, continuous coaching on a regular basis, development of talent, and elevating effective communication throughout the Operations team
  • Establish internal & external pipeline through succession planning and recruitment strategy
  • Writes an effective schedule that prioritizes the best business strategy, in partnership with the General Manager 

Flow Experience Leader 

  • Oversees the execution of certain deliverables on the Alo Sales and Service Model, protecting operational efficiency
  • Collaborates and implement General/Store Manager’s vision and work cross-functionally with business partners, as directed, to support all-level organizational goals
  • Demonstrate an ability to navigate the organization with a balance of business need and brand culture 

OPERATIONS MANAGER QUALIFICATIONS

  • Prior leadership experience in retail or related industry  
  • Working knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel and Outlook)  
  • Extraordinary interpersonal and communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Agile with the ability to handle multiple tasks in a changing environment
  • Highly Motivated by driving business in a fast-paced, innovative environment
  • Business owner mindset with an entrepreneurial spirit  
  • Independent work ethic, time management skills, and personal accountability  
  • Aligns with and embodies ALO’s Guiding Principles
  • Ability to lift, push, carry or otherwise move up to 50 pounds (23kg)
  • Ability to lift, bend, kneel, climb, crawl and/or twist, and safely climb up/down a ladder
  • Ability to stand and move for an entire shift 
  • Proof of right to live and work in country from start of employment

OPERATIONS MANAGER SCHEDULE

The Operations Manager role is a full-time role. To build a balanced schedule that supports the needs of the business and our teams, we expect all full-time employees to be available for opening, closing and weekend shifts, which may be subject to change. All Employees are expected to be able to work from the week of and including “Black Friday” until the end of the holiday season, first week of January. 

DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION STATEMENT

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, ALO does not discriminate against applicants or employees because of race, colour, creed, religion, sex, national origin, veteran status, disability, age, citizenship, marital or domestic/civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression or because of any other status or condition protected by statutory law. We are committed to an active Inclusion, Diversity and Equal Opportunities Policy, which starts with our recruitment and selection process, and we are happy to talk flexible working.

INTERVIEW PROCESS ADJUSTMENTS

If you consider yourself to require reasonable adjustments to any part of our recruitment process, we invite you to share those requirements with us when completing your application or by emailing .
